name: Maid Gakuen Kyousoukyoku
source:
Main character suddenly got a part-time job of personnel manager of four lovely candidates to maids. The goal is to train them into fabulous maids and win the "All Japan Maid Championship" in two months time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公突然得到一份兼职工作，负责管理4名可爱的女仆候选人。目标是在两个月内把她们训练成出色的女仆，并赢得“全日本女仆锦标赛”。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
